name: Page Settles
caption: Junior Paige Settles, of Floyds Knobs, Ind., calls the weekly Student Government Association meeting to order on Tuesday, March 22 at Downing Student Union.
why: She is the subject and she is doing the job: Speaker of the Senate calling her own meeting to order, inside her 2015-16 term. Herald spells her Paige; the worklist spells her Page.

name: Lillian Nellans
caption: Lily Nellans, a junior from Des Moines, Iowa, ran for Student Government Association president because she thought someone needed to listen to people whose voices aren't usually heard.
why: An SGA candidate photograph, caption is about her alone and about SGA. Herald calls her Lily; the worklist spells her Lillian. Corroborated by the surrogate-debate frame of 1 Nov 2016 naming 'Lily Nellans, junior from Des Moines, Iowa'.

name: Fransisco Serrano
caption: Sophomore Francisco Serrano asks panel of immigration lawyers questions submitted by the public about immigration, deportation and President Trump's executive orders ... on Feb. 28, 2017 in DSU.
why: Names him as a sophomore in February 2017, inside his 2016-17 SGA year, and he is the actor in the frame. Herald spells him Francisco; the worklist spells him Fransisco.

name: Katherine (Lane) Hedrick
caption: Junior Lane Hedrick, studied and interned in Bosnia over the summer. Hedrick interned at the Balkan Investigative Reporting Network, BIRN...
why: Single-subject feature photograph. 'Lane' is the nickname the worklist itself carries in brackets, and years.json puts Lane Hedrick on the Judicial Council the following year.

name: Elias Thompson
caption: Elias Thompson, a WKU junior From Spring Hill, TN, and Julianna Low, a WKU sophomore from White House, TN, spent the morning of September 28 canvassing Bowling Green neighborhoods for Andy Beshear's campaign.
why: Names him as a WKU junior in September 2019, inside his SGA year. Two people in frame; which is which must be settled from the image before use.

name: Joe Hunter
caption: Joe Hunter, the president of SVA, a current student at WKU and a former Marine, plants a handful of flags on the lawns of Centennial Mall to pay respect to the veterans he has known.
why: Single named subject, current WKU student. Check the frame actually shows his face and is not all back-of-head over the flags.

name: Hannah Neeper
caption: Student President Jay Todd Richey, left hugs Administrative Vice President Hannah Neeper, and Executive Vice President Kate Hart hugs Colton Hushell after the SGA results announcement on April 20, 2016 in Downing Student Union.
why: Caption gives her office and a partial position ('Richey, left'). Richey already has a portrait in data/photos, so the woman he is embracing can be fixed by matching his face. Group crop.

name: MJ Mayo
caption: WKU's Student Government Association participated in a town hall debate ... Executive Vice President Garrett Edmonds is running for Student Body President against MJ Mayo, senator for Potter College of Arts and Letters. Abbey Norvell is r...
why: Four frames of an SGA town hall debate naming him as a candidate. Edmonds and Norvell are identifiable from SGA's own headshots, so Mayo can be fixed by elimination. Full caption needs re-reading beyond the 300-char cut.

name: Kaycee Gibson
caption: ... WKU graduate Kaycee Gibson (far right), 22, of Horse Cave, Ky. who is the volunteer coordinator, says it receives 'tons of clothing donations almost every day...'
why: Caption carries an explicit position, '(far right)', which is a real key. Group crop.

name: Murphy Burke
caption: Frederick Higdon, left, Jay Richey, middle, and Dr. Barbra Burch, right, answer sophomore, Murphy Burke's question during the Student Forum held by the Presidential Search Committee Members ... April 27, 2016
why: Weak. The three named and positioned people are the panel; Burke is the questioner and may be facing away or out of frame. Only usable if the image plainly shows one person asking.

name: Courtney Hamilton
caption: Owensboro junior Courtney Hamilton and Louisville junior Emily Woodruff are residents in the newly constructed Kentucky Street Apartments owned by WKU.
why: Dated inside her SGA year, but two women named with no position given. Four frames exist from the shoot; only usable if one frame plainly holds a single person and the article text separates them.

name: William Berry
caption: Louisville senior Desmond Hutchison and Scottsville sophomore William Berry do triangle-hold exercises during their self-defense class.
why: Dated inside his SGA year and names him, but two men grappling with no position given. Note the worklist also carries 'J. William Berry' at 2015-16, who may or may not be the same man.
